A look for every drive

46 drives, each with one idea shown three ways: the model that orbits the fighter, the badge in menus, the 22 px chip on the HUD. Every drawing on this sheet is made from the same part list that would build the model.

Six shape languages

Family is readable from the outline alone. Each tile: the base form in black at 76 px and at orbit size (24 px), then as the model. Colour is the second cue, never the only one.

Fire

Tall, round at the foot, one sharp point up.
Taller than wide and uneven top to bottom. Nothing else in the set tapers upward.

Frost

Six-sided crystals and their clusters.
Straight edges at 60 degrees and points all round. The only family built on the hexagon.

Sky

Wide, swept and open: fans, arcs, carets, wings.
Wider than tall, with daylight through or under it. The only family that spreads sideways.

Tempo

A ring or a dial, with one thing that moves.
A round form with a hole reads at any size, and no other family is round.

Guard

Heavy plates and blocks with a flat top.
The most filled silhouette in the set: square shoulders, no hole, no point up.

Utility

Plain solids in sets of two or more.
Counted pieces with ink between them. No other family is made of separate equal parts.

Fire

Tall, round at the foot, one sharp point up. 8 drives. In the pool data: RED.
Ember
Common, ember
One flame with a hot core: the plain burst, and the family's base form.
Bolt
Common, bolt
A tall zigzag blade, sharp at both ends: it jumps to a foe.
Nova
Rare, nova
A flame between two blast arcs: the blast goes out around you.
Wildfire
Rare, wildfire
One tall flame with a small one thrown off to each side: the fire jumps to the others.
Spire
Rare, spire
A needle on a foot plate: it rises from the floor.
Kindle
Common, kindle
A struck match: a small flame on a stick. One hard hit lights it.
Cinder Heart
Rare, cinder_heart
A heart-shaped coal with a flame at the cleft: it keeps what it has burned.
Solar Flare
Epic, solar_flare
A rising half sun with five flame rays: fire from the sky.

Frost

Six-sided crystals and their clusters. 7 drives. In the pool data: PURPLE.
Frost
Common, frost
A six-armed ice crystal: the family's base form.
Shatter
Common, shatter
A hexagon broken in two, the halves slipped apart.
Hex
Common, hex
A hexagon cut through by a cross into four pieces: the mark it leaves.
Static
Common, static
An upright crystal with two barbs and a zigzag belt: charge held in ice.
Affliction
Rare, affliction
Four hexagons in a honeycomb: one cell for each word a foe can carry.
Contagion
Rare, contagion
One crystal budding three small ones: the word spreads outward.
Steam
Epic, steam
Half a crystal as a cup, three plumes rising from it: ice meeting fire.

Sky

Wide, swept and open: fans, arcs, carets, wings. 7 drives. In the pool data: YELLOW.
Feather Storm
Common, feather_storm
A fan of three feathers: the three it throws. The family's base form.
Gatekeeper

An open arch on two feet: the gate at the edge of the stage.
Comet

A ball thrown up off a wide arc: the wave that pops foes up.
Updraft
Common, updraft
Two wide carets, one over the other: a second lift.
Skyhook
Rare, skyhook
A hook with a small wing on its shank: it holds you in the air.
Meteor
Epic, meteor
A dart diving point down with three tails: the KO off the bottom.
Thunderhead
Rare, thunderhead
A flat-bottomed cloud with a small bolt under it.

Tempo

Rush
Common, rush
A wheel with three speed lines behind it.
Tailwind

A hoop with an arrow flying through it: the push from behind.
Clean Landing
Common, clean_landing
A ring with a tick in it: the landing was clean.

A bullseye of three bands: three clean landings in a row. The family's base form.
Slipstream

Quicksilver

Guard

Heavy plates and blocks with a flat top. 8 drives. In the pool data: BLUE.
Riposte
Common, riposte
A plate with a blade crossed behind it: the answer to a hit.
Insulate
Rare, insulate
A plate inside a second shell: two walls.
Bulwark

A dome on a slab: the cover that takes one hit.
Thorns

A plate with barbs on both sides: it hurts to hit.
Leech
Common, leech

Breaker

Last Stand

Utility

Plain solids in sets of two or more. 8 drives. In the pool data: WHITE.
Echo
Rare, echo
Three blocks, each smaller, stepping to the right: the repeat, and which way it looks.
Metronome
Common, metronome
A metronome with its arm swung over: change the beat.
Relay
Rare, relay
Two linked rings: the hand-off. The family's base form.
Surge
Rare, surge

Crescendo
Epic, crescendo

Snowball
Rare, snowball

Magpie
Common, magpie

Mirror
Epic, mirror
A diamond in two halves, the left solid and the right an empty outline: the copy of what is beside it.
Each card: the model as drawn in orbit (104 px, and at its real 24 px in the corner), the badge with its tier edge, the 22 px HUD chip, the name, tier and pool id, and why the shape. Original geometry. Fighters and stages elsewhere on these sheets are placeholders.
